answer_1.quote: Pre-trained Transformers have brought tremendous progress in summarizing text in an abstract manner. Unlike extractive summarization, abstractive summarization presents a blue-sky potential of generating summaries that are fluent and relevant to the source by intelligently paraphrasing salient contents rather than merely copying from source texts.

answer_2.quote: Assessed general metrics are: BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore and BARTScore.

answer_3.quote: BARTScore relies on a BART's average log-likelihood of generating the evaluated summary conditional on the source document...

answer_4.quote: We then perform fine-grained human analysis on the model outputs by three human annotators to qualitatively assess whether long document abstractive models can generate relevant and factually consistent summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Relevance measures whether a summary contains the main ideas of the source. Factual consistency measures whether a candidate summary is factually consistent with the source.
